subject: literacy
concept: Analyzing how diverse voices and perspectives are represented across a body of literature from one country or region
source_inspiration: original content, following the Education Conduct Policy's complete-truth and multi-perspective principles — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches excerpts from differing perspectives within one literary tradition to the distinct viewpoint each represents
exercise.abstract: Student explains how two differing perspectives within the same national literature offer different views of a shared experience

misconception_flags: treats one perspective as representative of the entire national literary tradition

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
